capabilities: Manage tasks as Markdown notes with frontmatter
Display tasks in kanban board and timeline views
Drag tasks between status columns to update frontmatter
Track priorities, dates, project and feature links, and custom fields
Filter and sort tasks with nested AND/OR filter groups
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10.0 or newer and the Bases core plugin to be enabled. Recurring tasks are listed on the roadmap as not yet implemented. README includes developer-focused release and manual install instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in task manager that keeps tasks as regular Markdown notes with frontmatter and renders them as kanban and timeline planning views.

relations.evidence: The plugin adds custom Bases views for planning work by status

summary: Task manager that stores tasks as Markdown notes with frontmatter and shows them in kanban board and timeline views built on Obsidian Bases.
